service.title: Update the privileged service?
service.body: The privileged service is version {serviceVersion}, which doesn't match Argus {version}. Some features may not work. Updating requires administrator permission.
service.bodyOlder: The privileged service is an older version that doesn't match Argus {version}. Some features may not work. Updating requires administrator permission.
service.restoresTaskManager: Updating first restores Windows Task Manager; the replacement can be turned on again in Settings afterwards.
service.done: The privileged service has been updated.
